k: A lab spider bred at Columbia University
st: On a school trip to a Columbia University lab, a genetically engineered spider bites Peter Parker.

k: An Oscorp formula for super soldiers
st: Chasing a military contract, Norman Osborn tests the enhancer on himself, and it makes him strong and insane.
Harry takes his father's enhancer and attacks Peter as a new Goblin.

k: Oscorp's armored flight suit and mask
st: Driven mad, Norman attacks in Oscorp's armored flight suit, and Jameson names its wearer the Green Goblin.
Harry shatters a mirror and finds his father's hidden storeroom of Green Goblin gear.
Pulled into another universe, Norman smashes the Goblin mask, but the Goblin soon fights on in the armor.
As the Green Goblin, Norman flies Oscorp's military glider into the Unity Day festival and attacks.
Norman sends it at Peter's back, but Peter dodges, and the glider skewers Norman instead.
Pulled into another universe, the Goblin flies it again, and its blade stabs his own world's Peter in the back.
The Green Goblin kills Oscorp's board with a pumpkin bomb at the Unity Day festival.
Fighting Peter, Harry is scarred by one of his own pumpkin bombs.
Peter throws one taken from Harry's home at the symbiote, and Eddie Brock dies in the blast.
Pulled into another universe, the Goblin hurls pumpkin bombs at that world's Peter Parker.

k: Peter's homemade red and blue suit
Peter's suit, worn in another universe
st: Peter designs a red and blue suit and fights crime as Spider-Man.
Losing his powers, Peter dumps the suit in an alley, and Jameson hangs it in his office.
His powers back, Peter takes the suit from the Bugle and stops Doc Ock's runaway train.
The symbiote turns the suit black as Peter sleeps, until he tears it off in a church bell tower.
Pulled into another universe, Peter wears it beside two other Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty.

k: A harness of four AI-driven arms
st: Otto Octavius runs his fusion demo with four AI-driven arms, kept in check by an inhibitor chip.
The failed demo fuses the arms to his spine and destroys the chip, and the arms take control of Otto.
Peter talks Otto back to himself, and Otto drowns his reactor in the river, sinking with the arms.
Pulled into another universe, Otto attacks Peter, Stark nanotech fuses to the arms, and Strange locks him up.
Peter fixes the inhibitor chip, and Otto uses the arms to help cure Max Dillon.
Otto's Oscorp-funded fusion demo goes unstable and kills his wife Rosie before Spider-Man shuts it down.
Otto rebuilds it in a harbor warehouse and trades Spider-Man to Harry for the tritium to fuel it.
As the new reactor runs wild, Otto drowns it in the river to save the city.
Using his father's Goblin technology, Harry attacks Peter on a new glider, then crashes and loses his memory.
Harry flies in to save Peter, but Eddie drives the glider at Peter, and Harry takes the blade.

k: Black alien ooze from a meteorite
st: A meteorite falls in Central Park near Peter and Mary Jane, and the symbiote oozes out onto Peter's moped.
It bonds to Peter's suit as he sleeps, turning it black, and Dr. Connors finds it is a symbiote.
Peter tears it off with a church bell, and it falls onto Eddie Brock below, creating Venom.
Peter pulls Eddie free with sound and throws a pumpkin bomb, and the symbiote and Eddie die together.

k: A locket with his sick daughter's photo
st: Turned to sand by a particle test, Flint Marko pulls himself together to reach his locket with his daughter's photo.
Aunt May gives Peter the ring Ben proposed with, but his plan to propose to Mary Jane falls apart.

k: Cross-species spiders in a locked Oscorp lab
Spiders bred from Richard Parker's research
st: Peter sneaks into a restricted Oscorp lab, and one of its genetically modified spiders bites him.
Harry learns Oscorp drained the spiders' venom before destroying them.
Harry forces Menken to inject him with the venom, and it twists him into a goblin.
Peter finds his father's briefcase, and in its papers the decay rate algorithm he takes to Dr. Connors.

k: Mechanical web-shooters with Oscorp web fluid
st: Peter builds mechanical web-shooters around a web formula made by Oscorp.
Fried by Electro in Times Square, they are magnetized with a car battery to stand up to him.

k: A spandex suit and mask with yellow lenses
Peter's suit, worn in another universe
st: Peter makes a spandex suit and a mask with yellow lenses and hunts Ben's killer as Spider-Man.
After Gwen's death, Peter stops wearing it for five months.
Moved by Gwen's graduation speech, Peter suits up again to face the Rhino.
Pulled into another universe, Peter fights in it beside two other Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty.

k: A formula to regrow limbs with lizard DNA
st: With the decay rate algorithm from Peter, Dr. Connors's lizard-DNA serum regrows a mouse's missing leg.
Fired by Ratha, Connors injects himself, regrows his arm and turns into the Lizard.

k: A cure for the Lizard's serum
st: Gwen makes an antidote to the Lizard's serum in an Oscorp lab.
Spider-Man releases it from atop Oscorp Tower, curing Connors and his victims.

k: A recording Richard leaves for his son
st: Before fleeing, Richard Parker records a video message explaining why he left Oscorp.
Peter finds it in his father's hidden lab and learns Richard refused to make weapons for Norman.

k: An armored suit Norman kept at Oscorp
st: Twisted by the spider venom, Harry puts on an armored suit his father had kept hidden at Oscorp.
Harry rides a mechanized glider to the power station and carries Gwen to the top of a clock tower.
From Ravencroft, Harry has an associate free Aleksei Sytsevich and give him Oscorp's rhino armor.

k: A set of mechanical arms in Oscorp's vault
st: A set of mechanical tentacle arms sits in Oscorp's hidden vault of special projects.

k: A pair of metal wings in Oscorp's vault
st: A pair of metal wings hangs in Oscorp's hidden vault of special projects.

k: Drake's ship to bring more symbiotes
st: Bonded to Riot, Carlton Drake readies a Life Foundation rocket to bring more symbiotes to Earth.
Venom damages it as it lifts off, and it explodes, killing Riot and Drake.
Venom explains the Codex, born when he revived Eddie, is the key Knull's Xenophages hunt to free him.
Venom gives his life in the acid tanks, and the Codex is destroyed with him.

k: A vial that held a piece of Venom
st: In the burned ruins of the army's base, a broken vial that held a sample of Venom lies beside a black cockroach.

k: A cure spliced from vampire bat genes
st: Michael splices vampire bat genes into himself aboard a ship at sea, and the cure turns him into a vampire.
Refused the cure, Milo secretly takes it and becomes a killer vampire too.
Michael, who turns down a Nobel Prize for it, lives on his artificial blood until it stops feeding his hunger.
Michael makes an antibody against vampirism, and his bats pin Milo down while he injects it, killing him.
Stranded in Michael's world, Adrian Toomes flies in wearing his winged suit and suggests they team up.

k: A rare spider with healing powers
st: In 1973 Peru, Constance Webb's team finds a rare spider with healing powers, and Ezekiel Sims steals it.
Cassie finds her mother's notes, which reveal who Ezekiel is and the true nature of his powers.

k: A family remedy that heals any wound
st: As a girl, Calypso heals the mauled Sergei with her serum, and it gives him animal strength and senses.

k: A tarot card left with the wounded boy
st: Calypso leaves a tarot card with the wounded Sergei, and he keeps it.

k: Made from the lion that mauled Sergei
st: Nikolai kills the lion that mauled Sergei, to teach his sons a lesson.
A year after his father's death, Kraven finds a vest made from that lion's skin, with a note from Nikolai, and puts it on.

k: A machine to reach other universes
st: Kingpin builds a super collider to reach other universes, and its test pulls Spider-People into Miles's world.
Miles sends his friends home, then throws Kingpin into the kill switch, and the collider is destroyed.
The Spot reveals the collider's blast filled his body with portals, and its test brought Miles's spider over.

k: A flash drive to shut down the collider
st: Dying, Peter Parker gives Miles a flash drive built to shut down Kingpin's collider.
After Miles damages it, the Spider-People make a new one, and Peter B. Parker means to use it himself.
Miles arrives, plugs in the drive himself, and sends the others home.
In an abandoned subway station, a spider marked 42 bites Miles, and he swats it dead.
The Spot reveals the spider came through Kingpin's collider from another universe, Earth-42.

k: A black suit Miles makes his own
st: At Aunt May's, Miles takes a black suit and web-shooters from Peter's hidden lab and spray-paints the suit his own way.
Sixteen months later, Miles wears it to fight the Spot and follow Gwen across universes.

k: A puzzle that baffles Spider-Man Noir
st: Spider-Man Noir, puzzled by a Rubik's Cube in Miles's world, takes it home with him.

k: Peni's robot, run with her spider
st: Peni Parker pilots SP//dr, a robot she runs through a psychic link with her spider, in Miles's world.
SP//dr is wrecked in the battle at the collider, and Peni goes home with only her spider.

k: Wrist devices for jumping between universes
st: Lyla tells Spider-Man 2099 his device for crossing universes works, and he jumps to Earth-67.
Gwen joins Miguel O'Hara's Spider-Society and gets one of its watches to jump between universes.

k: A bootleg device for jumping universes
st: Hobie leaves a makeshift portal watch with Gwen's father, who gives it to her after Miguel sends her home.

k: The Spider-Society's way to send people home
st: Margo helps Miles flee the Society through the Go Home Machine, but it drops him on Earth-42.
The Spot raids Earth-50101's Alchemax and absorbs its collider's power, and Miles saves Inspector Singh as it collapses.
In season 1, Spider-Man tracks the Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus and the Human Flies with his spider-tracers.
In season 1, the Sandman steals the Goliath Diamond and frames Spider-Man, who soaks him and takes it back.

k: A book of spells to summon demons
st: In season 1, the Green Goblin steals Grandini the Mystic's witchcraft book to summon demons of the Underworld.
In season 2, Jan Caldwell wears his father's Astro-Helmet to fly as Skyboy and rescue him from Dr. Zapp.

k: An alien ooze from an asteroid
st: In season 1, it rides John Jameson's shuttle to Earth, bonds to Spider-Man, then Eddie Brock, and is shot into space.
In season 3, Baron Mordo and Dormammu return it to Eddie, and Venom vanishes into a portal with Carnage.
In season 1, Spencer Smythe builds a Spider-Slayer for Norman Osborn, and his son Alistair builds more for the Kingpin.
In season 3, the Kingpin turns Alistair into a cyborg, the Ultimate Slayer.

k: A wonder drug that heals all wounds
st: In season 1, Mariah Crawford heals the lion-mauled Kraven with the Calypso Serum, and it makes him a crazed hunter.
In season 4, the same serum, given to Mariah to heal a plague, turns her into a feral werecat.
In season 1, Farley Stillwell uses Dr. Connors's Neogenic Recombinator to turn Mac Gargan into the Scorpion.
In season 2, Morbius tries to turn everyone into vampires with it, and Stillwell later destroys it.

k: An ancient tablet that restores youth
st: In season 2, Silvermane uses it to grow young until he is a baby, and Adrian Toomes uses its power as the Vulture.

k: A wand that opens the way to dark realms
st: In season 3, Baron Mordo's cult opens a portal to the Dark Dimension with it, until Spider-Man, Strange and Wong take it back.

k: A portal machine built for Stark
st: In season 3, Stark's accelerator is stolen, rebuilt and fought over, until Mary Jane and the Green Goblin vanish into its portal.

k: The formula that made Captain America
st: In season 4, the Kingpin forces the formula from John Hardesky, and Landon's version turns Felicia into the Black Cat.
In season 5, Spider-Man learns a different formula made the Six American Warriors, who need special rings to use their powers.
In season 5, the Red Skull's Doomsday Device charges his son Kragov with electricity, turning him into Electro.

k: A watch that makes the Thing human
st: In season 5, on the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom gives the Thing a watch that turns him human again.

k: A suit built from Reed Richards's nanotech
st: Blamed for John Jameson's lost ship, Peter builds a suit from Reed Richards's nanotech, with stealth and anti-symbiote weapons.
Venom and Carnage get aboard John Jameson's ship to Counter-Earth, where it crashes.

k: An alien that rode a shuttle home
st: In season 1, it rides John Jameson's shuttle home, bonds to Spider-Man, then Eddie Brock, until it is trapped in wet cement.
In season 2, Eddie finds it again as Venom, until Spider-Man strips it from him with a gene cleanser.

k: The Connors lab's cure for mutation
st: In season 1, Spider-Man cures the Lizard with Martha Connors's gene cleanser, then hides a spare vial under his desk.
In season 2, Eddie steals a gene cleanser to take Peter's powers, but Spider-Man uses it to strip away the symbiote.
In season 1, Harry secretly drinks Oscorp's formula, Globulin Green, and is unmasked as a Green Goblin.
In season 1, the Green Goblin steals a glider from an Oscorp lab and flies it against Spider-Man and the Big Man.
In season 2, the true Goblin, Norman Osborn, flies it until his final battle with Spider-Man.
In season 1, the Green Goblin's sabotage fuses Otto's mechanical arms to his body, and he forms the Sinister Six.
In season 1, Dr. Octavius bonds a rhino exoskeleton to Alex O'Hirn, who needs water to keep fighting in it.

k: A winged suit with anti-gravity tech
st: In season 1, Adrian Toomes builds a winged suit with the anti-gravity tech Oscorp stole from him and attacks Norman.
In season 1, Peter's web-shooters run dry against the Sandman and the Green Goblin, and he refuels them mid-fight.

k: A spider injected with Peter's blood
st: Oscorp injects spiders with Peter's blood, and one escapes through Strange's portal into the past to bite young Peter.
With the Avengers split by the Sokovia Accords, Peter tests Oscorp suits until he settles on a mostly white one.

k: A suit Harry has built for Peter
st: Harry has Oscorp scientists build Peter the red and blue suit he imagined, and he wears it against the Scorpion.

k: Gamma-powered gear with an infinity logo
st: Otto Octavius secretly sells gamma-powered gear marked with an infinity logo to criminals across the city.
After Otto's arrest his technology goes to Oscorp, and a gas from it gives Lonnie Lincoln rock-hard skin.

k: A laser helmet that predicts moves
st: Otto sells Mila Masaryk a laser-firing helmet that predicts moves, and she frees her crew from prison as the Unicorn.
Mikhail takes the helmet from her to spare Spider-Man, and Spider-Man hands them both to the police.
Otto equips Mac Gargan with scorpion-like armor, and as the Scorpion he nearly kills Spider-Man.
Spider-Man beats Gargan savagely until Lonnie stops him, and Gargan is arrested.
Norman sends a glider to pull Peter away before the Scorpion can kill him.

k: A gateway to space for Project Monolith
st: Norman reveals the interns' projects have all been building a gateway to space for his secret Project Monolith.
Norman opens it despite Strange's warning, the alien comes through, and Strange and Peter destroy it.

k: A piece of the alien left on Earth
st: After the alien is sent back to space, Norman finds a piece of the symbiote left behind.
Ben steals Dr. Faber's files, which show her attempts at a cure have only worsened the metahumans.
Faber finally makes a cure from Ben's organs and uses it to restore her son Ogden's true age.
As her lab burns, Ben escapes with the cure.
Ben makes doses for every metahuman, and Robbie injects one into Lonnie Lincoln.
Ben gives the last dose to Flint Marko, giving up his own chance to be human, so Marko can be with Cat.
Ben stops being the Spider after his fiancee Ruby is killed by a criminal he caught.
When Silvermane's men threaten Janet, Ben puts on the Spider's costume again.
